description: Every NinjaOne report, plus a local store that answers fleet-wide questions no single API call can: patch compliance, backup gaps, AV blast-radius, health, drift.

auth_env_var_specs.name: NINJAONE_CLIENT_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: OAuth2 client_id from NinjaOne Administration > Apps > API.

auth_env_var_specs.name: NINJAONE_CLIENT_SECRET
auth_env_var_specs.description: OAuth2 client_secret from NinjaOne Administration > Apps > API.

novel_features.name: Fleet patch-compliance rollup
novel_features.description: One row per organization showing percent OS-patched, percent software-patched, failed counts, and the worst-offender device across your whole fleet.

novel_features.name: Backup-coverage gap finder
novel_features.description: Lists every device with no backup usage (or zero bytes / stale job), grouped by organization, so unprotected endpoints surface immediately.

novel_features.name: Software sprawl audit
novel_features.description: For each software title, counts the distinct versions installed across the fleet and where each version lives; flags titles fragmented across many versions.

novel_features.name: Fleet health score
novel_features.description: A transparent 0-100 score per organization from patch, backup, AV, and stale-device signals, with the contributing deductions itemized.

novel_features.name: AV threat fleet sweep
novel_features.description: Given a threat name or a stale-definition window, lists every device fleet-wide carrying it, grouped by organization and location.

novel_features.name: Stale / abandoned device detector
novel_features.description: Lists devices whose last contact exceeds a threshold, with days-since and owning organization and location.

novel_features.name: Unsupported-OS / EOL exposure
novel_features.description: Lists devices running end-of-life operating systems, grouped by organization, against a curated EOL reference table.

novel_features.name: Fleet drift (week-over-week)
novel_features.description: Diffs the current sync against the previous stored snapshot to show which organizations got better or worse on patch, backup, or stale metrics.
